why: In A the circle is cut into two halves; in B the top half is flipped upside down and the bottom half stays the same. Do the same to the parallelogram in C: the top half flips, so its sides now lean the other way, and the shape gets a pointed side like >. Option 3 shows this. Option 4 is tempting but there the bottom half was flipped instead of the top half.
trick: When a figure is cut into halves, check which half is flipped and which half stays fixed.
